system.description:
Range: Touch

You inscribe an astral rune onto a weapon, so that it causes spiritual as well as physical damage.

Choose a weapon held by yourself or an adjacent creature. The first time that weapon deals Damage within the next 1 minute, it gains the Magical trait, and deals additional damage equal to your Soul.

When you use this ability, you can choose to spend 1 Resolve to increase the additional Damage to double your Soul.

Wounds inflicted by this attack do not recover naturally and require active treatment to be healed. Lost Stamina recovers normally.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.P9r9g6Qh8qKjiWfz]{Astral Fang}
